name: Triple confluence with momentum-confirm: fear + VIX + funding flush, only after a positive 3d turn
rationale: Thesis: capitulation triples often fire mid-crash (falling knife). Adding a short-horizon momentum CONFIRM — require ret_3d to have already turned positive (the first green bar after the flush) — should convert a knife-catch into a confirmed bottom, trading a touch of upside for a much higher hit-rate and shallower drawdown. Core stress triple: fear_greed extreme-low, vix_level elevated, funding_rate flushed. ret_3d is a SIGNED return used via its lookback param and a positive-side threshold (the confirm), never a drifting level. Long-only spot. Disconfirmer: must beat the SAME triple WITHOUT the ret_3d confirm (the pure knife-catch) on deflated Sharpe after fees AND show lower max-drawdown; if the knife-catch matches, the momentum confirm is decorative. Honest FAIL valid.
catalyst: stress triple followed by the first positive 3-day return (confirmed turn)
